model.dq_warehouse.dim_customers.compiled_code:
-- customer profile dimension with lifetime order aggregates
with customer_orders as (
    select
        customer_id,
        count(*)           as order_count,
        sum(total_amount)  as total_spend,
        max(order_ts)      as last_order_ts
    from "warehouse"."marts"."fct_orders"
    group by customer_id
)
select
    c.customer_id,
    c.email,
    c.state,
    c.signup_date,
    coalesce(o.order_count, 0)    as order_count,
    coalesce(o.total_spend, 0)    as total_spend,
    o.last_order_ts               as last_order_ts,
    c._batch_id                   as _first_loaded_batch_id,
    c._loaded_at                  as _first_loaded_at
from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_customers" c
left join customer_orders o on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
model.dq_warehouse.dim_customers.name: dim_customers

model.dq_warehouse.fct_daily_revenue.compiled_code:
-- daily revenue rollup from order facts
select
    order_ts::date       as order_date,
    count(*)             as orders,
    sum(total_amount)    as revenue,
    sum(payment_total)   as collected
from "warehouse"."marts"."fct_orders"
group by 1
order by 1
model.dq_warehouse.fct_daily_revenue.name: fct_daily_revenue

model.dq_warehouse.fct_orders.compiled_code:
-- order facts enriched with payment totals and item counts
with payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(amount)  as payment_total,
        count(*)     as payment_count
    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_payments"
    group by order_id
),
items as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(quantity) as item_qty,
        count(*)      as item_count
    from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_order_items"
    group by order_id
)
select
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_ts,
    o.status,
    o.total_amount,
    coalesce(p.payment_total, o.total_amount) as payment_total,
    coalesce(p.payment_count, 0)              as payment_count,
    coalesce(i.item_qty, 0)                   as item_qty,
    coalesce(i.item_count, 0)                 as item_count,
    o._batch_id,
    o._loaded_at
from "warehouse"."staging"."stg_orders" o
left join payments p on p.order_id = o.order_id
left join items   i on i.order_id = o.order_id
model.dq_warehouse.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
